added_alternatives.description: No provider in the directory lists functional neurosurgery, so no appointment can be offered for this request. A referral coordinator can take the case, look outside the directory and place it in a queue. Nothing will be booked on your behalf: you will still be asked to approve the hospital, the doctor and the appointment before anything is confirmed.

operator_notes: The directory has no functional neurosurgery provider at any hospital in the fixture set. Widening the radius to 40 miles still returns nothing, and I am not going to invent a clinic to fill the gap. I have queued the case and told the patient what will happen next.

The referring practice faxed the echocardiogram report at 09:55. I attached it to the workflow without touching the checks that had already passed; the readiness check re-ran the prior report item only.
